title: مؤونة الطريق
starting_condition: Complete Mission 002, then speak to Nora Blake near the Marsa Al-Noor lighthouse.

stages.objective: Speak to Nora to receive the supply request.
Enter the physical Harbor Market shop interior.
Buy one bottle of water using the live shop inventory and wallet.
Deliver the purchased bottle of water to Claire Bennett.
Receive the $150 reward and continue exploring.

notes: This is a provisional original story proposal and not a final approved chapter outline.
The shop is an enterable in-world room with collision, entry/exit interactions, a clickable purchase/sell panel, stock limits and player inventory.
Shop stock, player inventory, wallet, mission progress and economy ledger are part of the versioned live-game save payload.
Dialogue remains text-only. No Arabic voice performance is claimed.
